## About
Puzzuoli's Auto Services, also known as Puzzuoli's Mr. Muffler, is a local small business owned and operated by Chris and Jim Puzzuoli. Both are lifelong Dearborn residents and fully licensed and certified auto technicians.
Our work covers alignments, brakes, CV joints, belts and hoses, mufflers and exhaust, shocks and struts, oil changes, batteries, alternators, starters and tires. We stock brands like Interstate, Gates, Monroe, Raybestos, Moog and Shell for all makes and models.
You'll get the courtesy and respect you deserve, and we focus on what your car actually needs. We're rated 4.6 on Google from 148 reviews. Stop in and see Chris, Jim and the rest of the crew.

## Services
- Undercar services: Brakes, alignments, shocks, struts, CV joints, belts, hoses, batteries and oil changes for all makes and models.
- Tire repair, replacement and rotation: Tire repair, replacement and rotation, with Cooper tires in house and all brands available.
